name: Girl Grind Beverage Co.
where: On the corner of Bethpage Road and South Main Street · walk-in or drive-thru
tagline: A specialty drink shop, walk-in or drive-thru: coffees, customizable fizzy sodas, energy drinks, milkshakes and smoothies, plus pre-packaged sweets and snacks.
about: Girl Grind Beverage Co. makes every drink to order with just one or two people behind the counter, so drinks are made fresh, and with lots of love. There are hundreds of fizzy flavor combinations: be as creative as you want or stick to the house creations. Each month brings new signature drinks, and the monthly Girl Grind Market brings local vendors together.
hours_note: Hours aren't posted on the shop's website. Call (704) 659-1957.
